title: MUJI Sensitive Skin High Moisture Toner 400ml
description_en: MUJI's no-nonsense toner for sensitive skin — hypoallergenic, fragrance-free, colorant-free, and free from 9 common irritants. Generous 400ml size. The toner trusted by millions of minimalist skincare devotees.
description_ja: 無印良品の敏感肌用高保湿化粧水。9つの無添加処方でアレルギーテスト・スティンギングテスト済み。400mlの大容量で惜しみなく使える、ミニマリストスキンケアの定番。
